title: Phylogenetic Hypothesis Schema
description: Defines a rooted phylogenetic tree representing a published evolutionary hypothesis. Terminal nodes reference taxa from the taxonomy; internal nodes are hypothesis-specific ancestors.

hypothesisId.description: Stable, unique identifier for this hypothesis. Prefixed with 'phylo_'. Scopes all internal node IDs and divergence estimates.

hypothesisName.description: Human-readable name for this hypothesis (e.g., 'dos Reis et al. 2018 Time-Tree').

source.description: Citation or DOI for the published source (e.g., 'doi:10.1016/j.cub.2018.03.056').

sourceMetadata.description: Additional metadata about the source publication. Optional.

rootNodeId.description: ID of the root node (most recent common ancestor of all taxa). Must be an internal node ID.

terminalIdPrefix.description: Prefix used for terminal node IDs in this hypothesis (typically 'tax_'). Allows validation that terminals reference taxa.

internalIdPrefix.description: Prefix used for internal (ancestral) node IDs in this hypothesis (e.g., 'ancestor_h1_'). Includes hypothesis identifier for scoping.

nodes.description: Array of all nodes in the tree (terminal and internal). Must form a valid rooted tree.

id.description: Unique node identifier within this hypothesis. Terminals start with terminalIdPrefix; internals start with internalIdPrefix.

type.description: Node type: 'terminal' for taxon reference, 'internal' for ancestor.

parentId.description: ID of parent node. Null for root node only. All non-root nodes must have a parent.

children.description: Internal nodes require at least 1 child; terminal nodes require an empty array.

taxonId.description: Taxonomic ID this node represents. Required for terminal nodes. Optional for internal nodes (e.g., when an internal node has been designated as an animal taxon). Must match a taxon in taxonomy when present.

branch_length.description: Branch length from parent to this node. Represents evolutionary time (typically in millions of years for paleontological sources). Preserved from source hypothesis.

confidence.description: Confidence or bootstrap value for this node, if available from the source. Format depends on the source.

original_name.description: Original label or clade name from the source hypothesis. Useful for provenance and debugging.

age_ma.description: Age of this node in millions of years ago (Ma), calculated as the root age minus the accumulated branch lengths from the root. Computed from ultrametric source tree. Only present when age data has been explicitly added to the hypothesis.

descendant_species_count.description: Total number of terminal descendants (terminal species) beneath this node. Present only for internal nodes.

descendant_composition.description: Count of descendants by taxonomic group. Present only for internal nodes.

immediate_child_count.description: Number of immediate (direct) children. Present only for internal nodes.

child_branch_species_counts.description: Array of terminal descendant counts for each immediate child, in child order. Sum must equal descendant_species_count. Present only for internal nodes.

taxonomic_summary.description: Deepest shared taxonomic classification of descendants. Present only for internal nodes with at least 2 descendants sharing a classification.

rank.description: Taxonomic rank of the shared classification.

method.description: Method used to derive this summary. Currently only 'deepest_shared_descendant_taxon' is supported.

descendant_species_count.description: Number of descendants sharing this classification.
